name: Cart Bounce – Cart Recovery for WooCommerce, Gravity Forms, WPForms, EDD, PMPro and more
author: IdeaWP

sections.description:
Cart Bounce is a powerful and easy-to-use abandoned cart recovery plugin that helps you recover lost sales by sending customizable reminder emails, text messages, and WhatsApp messages to your customers. Whether you’re using WooCommerce, Gravity Forms, WPForms, Paid Membership Pro, or Easy Digital Downloads, Cart Bounce is built to work seamlessly with your favorite WordPress plugins, ensuring no abandoned cart goes unnoticed.

Features

  • Seamless Integrations: Works with popular WordPress plugins like WooCommerce, Gravity Forms, WPForms, Paid Membership Pro, and Easy Digital Downloads.
  • Customizable Notifications: Create fully customizable email templates to send timely reminders to users who abandon their carts.
  • Multi-Channel Notifications: In addition to email, you can send text messages or WhatsApp messages to re-engage customers.
  • Flexible Scheduling: Set up multiple reminder notifications with different timing to increase the chances of recovering abandoned carts.
  • Detailed Reports: Monitor your recovery success with detailed reporting and analytics on sent notifications and recovered carts.
  • Easy Setup: Quick and simple setup process – start recovering carts in minutes.

Upcoming Features

  • More integrations with popular plugins.
  • Enhanced reporting and analytics.
  • Advanced segmentation options for targeted recovery campaigns.

Usage

  1. Once activated, go to the Cart Bounce > Notifications page.
  2. Choose the integration you want to use (e.g., WooCommerce, Gravity Forms, etc.).
  3. Customize your reminder emails, text messages, or WhatsApp messages.
  4. Set up your notification schedule to ensure timely reminders.
  5. Start recovering abandoned carts!

Third party services

Cart bounce relies on the following third-party services to provide its functionalities:

Twilio
– Description: Twilio’s API is used to send SMS notifications.
– Link: Twilio
– Terms of Use: Twilio Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy: Twilio Privacy Policy

WhatsApp Business API

  • Description: Cart bounce integrates with the WhatsApp Business API to send WhatsApp messages.
  • Link: WhatsApp Business API
  • Terms of Use: WhatsApp Business API Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: WhatsApp Privacy Policy
  • Privacy protection WhatsApp Privacy Protection

Support

If you have any questions or need assistance, please visit our support page or reach out to us through the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress repository or upload the cart-bounce.zip file through the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Cart Bounce > Settings in your WordPress dashboard to configure Twilio and WhatsApp details.
  4. Navigate to Cart Bounce > Notifications and start creating you reminder notifications.

Follow this guide for more documentation on how to use Cart Bounce.
sections.faq:
Which plugins are supported by Cart Bounce?

Cart Bounce currently supports WooCommerce, Gravity Forms, WPForms, Paid Membership Pro, and Easy Digital Downloads. We’re constantly working on adding more integrations.

How does Cart Bounce send notifications?

Cart Bounce sends customizable emails, text messages, or WhatsApp messages through the integrations you choose (e.g., using Twilio for text and WhatsApp notifications).

Can I create multiple reminders?

Yes! You can create and schedule multiple reminders to be sent at different times to increase the chances of recovering an abandoned cart.

Where can I find the documentation?

You can find the documentation on our documentation site.
